subject: Post-signing deployment play & stewardship assignments
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@astrahealth.com>, Tim Chambers <tim.chambers@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-signing deployment play & stewardship assignments

Hi Elaine / Tim —

Thanks again for finalizing the MSA today — really excited to get AstraHealth live. Attached are the signed MSA and the SOW v3 we agreed on. This thread is the official handoff from Sales to Customer Success / Implementation. Below is a concise play we propose and the initial owner map so everyone is clear on next steps.

High-level objectives:
- Walk up a production-ready inference pipeline for patient triage models with Redwood in your VPC; baseline SLA 99.5% monthly availability, 95th pct latency target under 220ms for 512-token requests.
- Delivery window: pilot environments online within 4 weeks; production rollout in weeks 10–12 after pilot sign-off.

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — proposed milestones (dates are optimistic / contingent on procurement):
1) Day 0–7: Contract & billing complete; exchange of keys and access (DocuSign/Finance).
2) Day 7–14: Technical kickoff — infra checklist, network allowlists, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence review.
3) Week 3–4: Staging environment provisioned; model onboarding + inference smoke tests.
4) Week 5–8: Pilot run; telemetry baseline and quality evals; iterate sampling prompts.
5) Week 10–12: Production cutover and operational runbook handoff.

Owner map (initial):
- Redwood Sales Sponsor / Handoff Lead: Rafael Mendes (me) — open questions, contracts escalation.
- CS / Implementation Owner: Marissa Cole — overall delivery owner, acceptance.
- Technical Lead (Redwood infra): Vivek Kulkarni — build/ops lead, access, deployment automation.
- Solutions / Prompting SME: Karthik Iyer — model quality and evals.

Open items for AstraHealth to confirm:
- Procurement timeline for invoice + PO (will affect Day 0).
- Network contact for allowlists and whether infra sits in their GCP org or we deploy into a Redwood-managed VPC.
- Which internal test dataset (PHI-scrubbed) will be used for the pilot.

Attachments: signed_msa_astra.pdf, astra_sow_v3.pdf, soc2_report_redacted.pdf

Next actions (proposed within 48 hours):
1) Elaine/Tim confirm procurement ETA and network contact.
2) Marissa to propose 3 slots for technical kickoff next week.
3) Vivek to open a provisioning ticket and share initial infra checklist.

Elaine / Tim — over to you to confirm procurement / network contact and whether the pilot uses your staging data or synthetic.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Date: Wed, 29 Feb 2028 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-signing deployment play & stewardship assignments

Thanks Rafael — great summary and congrats team. Hi Elaine / Tim, pleasure to meet you electronically. I'll be the delivery owner for the implementation and will coordinate resources across onboarding, SRE, and QA. A few quick clarifications from my side before we lock the MAP: 

1) Acceptance criteria — propose we codify the pilot acceptance into three measurable gates:
   - Gate A (Infra readiness): staging environment passes allowlist tests, KMS keys validated, basic ingestion tests (smoke OK).
   - Gate B (Quality & telemetry): inference throughput >= 80% of baseline target and initial quality checks (precision metrics) above agreed thresholds on test set.
   - Gate C (Operational readiness): runbook published, alerting configured, run a 48-hour soak with <1% error rate.

2) Dependencies I need from AstraHealth by EOD Friday:
   - Procurement ETA / PO number (for billing).
   - Network contact name + CIDR ranges for allowlist.
   - Small sample of scrubbed test payloads (S3 link or secure share).

I've tentatively assigned Vivek as the Redwood technical lead and Karthik as our model/quality lead. Vivek — can you confirm you have capacity to start the provisioning ticket and share the infra checklist by Friday?

Elaine — once you confirm procurement cadence I'll set up a 60-minute technical kickoff. Suggested times: Thu 03/02 16:00 UTC, Fri 03/03 14:00 UTC, Mon 03/06 18:00 UTC.

I'll also create a shared Confluence runbook and a HubSpot onboarding checklist and post links here when ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Elaine Park <elaine@astrahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 08:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-signing deployment play & stewardship assignments

Marissa / Rafael — thanks for the clear plan and congrats on getting to this stage. A few items from procurement and security side: 

- Procurement: our finance team expects an initial invoice and PO within 5 business days. I'll coordinate and share a PO number by Thu 03/02 EOD; if there's anything specific the finance team needs on the invoice, flag it.
- Network: our infra lead is Samir Patel (samir.patel@astrahealth.com). I'll introduce him on the kickoff invite — CIDR ranges to follow.
- Data for pilot: we will provide a small PHI-scrubbed payload set via secure SFTP. ETA for delivery: Fri 03/03 COB.
- SOC2: thanks for the redacted report — our security team will review and may request one additional control narrative; I'll push back if needed.

We can confirm the technical kickoff for Fri 03/03 14:00 UTC. That works for Samir and Tim.

Quick question: will Redwood deploy the inference runtime inside our GCP project or into a Redwood-managed private tenant? The decision affects networking and KMS responsibilities.

Elaine Park
Director of Digital Platforms | AstraHealth
elaine@astrahealth.com | +1 (202) 555-0123

Acknowledged — I'll open the provisioning ticket now and paste the infra checklist here for quick visibility. Draft checklist (short):
- Confirm hosting mode (Customer GCP project vs Redwood-managed private tenant)
- Allowlist entries + VPN / bastion requirements
- KMS integration details & key rotation window
- Service account roles + least-privilege IAM policy
- S3 / GCS bucket access pattern for telemetry and artifacts
- Quantization / model artifact format to be used (FP16 / Q4_0)
- Monitoring endpoints and Grafana dashboard template

I'll also create a shared Confluence page and add the preliminary runbook; Marissa, I'll invite you and the Astra team. If procurement delivers PO by Thu EOD, I can provision a staging cluster by Monday morning (03/06).

-Vivek
